sections.title: Account review queue
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,review_due,review_status from account_portfolio where status='active' order by review_due nulls first

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select account,name,owner,due,attention from action_queue where status='open' order by due

sections.title: Account coverage
sections.sql: select name,decision_makers,quiet_contacts,overdue_actions from account_portfolio order by code

sections.title: Relationships needing attention
sections.sql: select account,name,title,influence,last_contact,attention from relationship_gaps where status='active' order by account,name

sections.title: Known and unknown coverage
sections.note: Potential is a planning estimate, not booked revenue. Currency stays on every row. A blank estimate is unknown.
sections.sql: select account,business_unit,product,status,competitor,potential_cents,currency,attention from whitespace order by account,code
